cards.description:
Series on `feat/cli-source-of-truth`. The `dashboard` daemon owns the databases; the server and MCP become clients reaching it over loopback.

Landed:
- 5ed266b docs: decide the CLI owns the data, server and MCP become clients
- cfa6e60 the daemon owns the databases, commands reach it over loopback
- 45b02f3 daemon start/stop/status, running until it is told to stop
- c55ac76 drop `--home`, resolve the home from where the command runs
- 7ebf771 drop `--server`; every command uses its home's daemon

Left: `.mcp.json` at the repo root and the `website/docs/mcp.md` client-setup section.
cards.title: CLI is the source of truth: the daemon owns the data

cards.description:
Done — `conceptions/cli-as-source-of-truth.md` § Transport decides it: loopback TCP, not a unix socket, because `DashboardClient` is `URLSession` and cannot dial a unix domain socket. No framing or handshake to specify; version skew stays open as T-52.

Drift: the note fixes the port at `MVP_DASHBOARD_DAEMON_PORT`, default 5174; the code binds `:0` and publishes `<home>/daemon.port`. The note's own ponytail line allows that, but it now describes something the code does not do. — SRV-19 (S)
cards.title: T-43 Decide the daemon socket protocol

cards.description: Done cfa6e60 + 45b02f3 + 7ebf771. `Sources/DashboardCLI/Commands/DaemonCommand.swift`: start/stop/status/run, binds 127.0.0.1 on port 0 and publishes `<home>/daemon.port` with its pid. Loopback port instead of a unix socket; Vapor is the accept loop; `DashboardRuntime.register` runs here (and in `serve`, which takes the home over rather than opening it beside the daemon). — SRV-19 (L)
cards.title: T-44 `dashboard daemon`: the process that owns the home

cards.description: Done cfa6e60. `Sources/DashboardClient/RemoteCommands.swift` — HTTP over loopback, not a socket. — SRV-19 (M)
cards.title: T-45 Socket-backed command protocol implementations

cards.description: Open — I marked this done earlier on a wrong reading. `ServeCommand` still calls `configure(app:)`, which calls `DashboardRuntime.register`: it owns the databases itself and merely evicts the daemon first via `DaemonHandover.takeOver`. `conceptions/cli-as-source-of-truth.md` D-4 decides the opposite — `serve` connects and its container is deleted — and nothing in `docs/` records the change. Either do D-4 or amend the note; that is a decision, not a patch. — SRV-19 · T-45 (M)

cards.description: Done 7ebf771. `Runtime.open` → `DaemonProcess.connect`: reads `daemon.port`, spawns `dashboard daemon run` when nothing answers and polls for 10s; a lock older than 30s is removed. — SRV-19 (M)

cards.description:
Introduce agent-centric features to enhance AI integration visibility and cost tracking — these improvements align with T-8 and T-11, but expand into full dashboard-level functionality. The goal is to make agent selection, display, and financial context more prominent in the project flow — improving user control and analytics.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Agent selection visible in DraftWithAI interface
- [ ] Agent appears in activity panel and cost details on card
- [ ] Cost history displayed for each card
- [ ] All UI elements rendered across test environments
cards.title: Implement agent-focused dashboard features across Draft and card view

cards.description: Show the selected agent in the activity summary and include its cost in the card’s financial breakdown — improves transparency and tracking.
